decision: Owner, Phase 1 gate review 2026-11-10: funds and investment trusts get insufficient_data from the operating-decline gate.
note: Reviewed per-ticker decisions for src/value_investor/fund_or_trust.py. The automatic rules (sector label 'Investment Trust' and similar, Yahoo industry 'Closed-End Fund', quote type ETF/MUTUALFUND, names containing 'investment trust' or 'fund' but not 'fund management') run after this list. REITs are operating property companies and are never classified as funds unless listed here. Add a name only after reading what it is; a change here moves a verdict, so it goes through a PR.

GCP.L.name: GCP Infrastructure Investments Limited
GCP.L.why: listed closed-end infrastructure debt fund; revenue is investment income

BHMG.L.name: BH Macro Limited
BHMG.L.why: listed closed-end fund (feeder into a macro hedge fund)

SYNC.L.name: Syncona Limited
SYNC.L.why: listed investment company reporting on a net-asset-value basis

III.L.name: 3i Group plc
III.L.why: self-managed investment company; IFRS 10 investment entity reporting gross investment return and NAV, so the revenue line is portfolio return. Borderline: it also runs a fee-earning manager. Owner may move it to operating.

IPO.L.name: IP Group plc
IPO.L.why: holds a venture portfolio at fair value and reports NAV; income is portfolio gains. Borderline: not an investment trust by legal form.

JZCP.L.name: JZ Capital Partners Limited
JZCP.L.why: listed closed-end investment company in run-off

DGI9.L.name: Digital 9 Infrastructure PLC
DGI9.L.why: listed investment trust (digital infrastructure) in managed wind-down

GROW.L.name: Molten Ventures plc
GROW.L.why: listed venture capital investment company reporting NAV

INDU-C.ST.name: AB Industrivärden (publ)
INDU-C.ST.why: investment company holding listed stakes; reports NAV, no consolidated operating revenue

SOF.BR.name: Sofina SA
SOF.BR.why: investment company; IFRS 10 investment entity reporting NAV

JUP.L.name: Jupiter Fund Management Plc
JUP.L.why: asset manager: fee revenue and operating margin are its business

ICG.L.name: ICG plc
ICG.L.why: alternative asset manager; fee-earning business with a balance-sheet book

POLN.L.name: Pollen Street Group Limited
POLN.L.why: former investment trust, now an asset manager with an investment balance sheet since the 2022 merger with its manager

CLIG.L.name: City of London Investment Group Plc
CLIG.L.why: asset manager (not the City of London Investment Trust)

PMV.AX.name: Premier Investments Limited
PMV.AX.why: retailer (Smiggle, Peter Alexander) despite 'Investments' in the name

ACKB.BR.name: Ackermans & van Haaren NV
ACKB.BR.why: holding company that consolidates operating subsidiaries (DEME and others)

SOL.AX.name: Washington H. Soul Pattinson and Company Limited
SOL.AX.why: investment house that consolidates operating subsidiaries; kept operating, borderline
